description: This file contains Google Test unit tests for the Telemetry plugin implementation in a C++ project, including mocks, test fixtures, and test cases to verify functionality like initialization, report uploading, and event handling.

classes.name: T2Test
classes.description: Test fixture for initializing and cleaning up telemetry mock implementation with expectations.

classes.name: TelemetryTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing the Telemetry plugin including mocks for service, power events, and plugin interface.

classes.name: TelemetryRfcTest
classes.description: Derived fixture adding RFC mock setup for testing default profile initialization.

classes.name: TelemetryRBusTest
classes.description: Derived fixture for testing RBUS-based report uploads and event handling in the Telemetry plugin.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test case verifying presence of core methods in the handler.

methods.name: InitializeDefaultProfile
methods.description: Test default profile initialization via RFC parameter setting with correct file creation.

methods.name: InitializeDefaultProfileRFCFailure
methods.description: Test behavior when RFC parameter setting fails during initialization.

methods.name: InitializeZeroSizeDefaultProfile
methods.description: Test initialization when default profile file exists but is zero-size.

methods.name: InitializePersistentFolder
methods.description: Test that persistent folder creation and report file handling during init succeed.

methods.name: Plugin
methods.description: Test plugin initialization, RPC method invocation handling, and event simulation.

methods.name: uploadLogsRbusOpenFailure
methods.description: Test behavior when opening RBUS fails, expecting an error response.

methods.name: uploadLogsRbusMethodFailure
methods.description: Test failure in invoking RBUS method, expecting RPC call failure response.

methods.name: uploadLogsCallbackFailed
methods.description: Test callback that signals failure, expects report submission with failure status.

methods.name: uploadLogsGetValueFailure
methods.description: Test RBUS value retrieval returning null, expecting a failure and report submission.

methods.name: uploadLogsFailure
methods.description: Test RBUS success but report upload indicates failure, ensuring correct reporting.

methods.name: uploadLogs
methods.description: Test successful report upload scenario with success status notification.

methods.name: uploadLogsOnStandby
methods.description: Simulate power state change to standby and verify upload of DCM report.

methods.name: uploadLogsOnDeepSleep
methods.description: Simulate deep sleep power state change and verify abort report request.
